NPC training, recipe unlocks and profession gates

Trainers sell or grant validated ability/profession/recipe unlocks through a service catalog. They do not directly modify skill arrays in a widget or own duplicate progression records.

Scope and player interaction

Trainers sell or grant validated ability/profession/recipe unlocks through a service catalog. They do not directly modify skill arrays in a widget or own duplicate progression records.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase20committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

OffersLoading → Eligible → Locked → PurchasePending → Learned → Rejected

WBP_Skills observes results from URPGTrainingComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Trainer_Tovin. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
TrainerId and OfferId: versioned authored catalog
UnlockKind: Ability|Recipe|Profession|RespecService
Requirements: class/level/reputation/profession/quest IDs
PriceBaseCurrency and QuoteExpiry: server-calculated
UnlockEntitlementId: unique character/offer or definition key

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGTrainingComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_SkillsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
GetTrainingOffers(TrainerContext) -> OfferViews
PurchaseTraining(CommandId, QuoteId) -> Learned|AlreadyKnown|RequirementsFailed|InsufficientFunds

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Interact with Tovin and receive offers filtered by current character build and service permissions.
  2. UI shows missing requirements and exact quote; confirmation sends only the quote/offer identity.
  3. Backend validates range/session through trusted zone context, requirements, currency and existing entitlement.
  4. Commit currency debit and unique unlock in one transaction; return updated profession/recipe/ability IDs.
  5. Zone rebuilds appropriate GAS/crafting/profession view and UI marks Learned.
  6. Respec delegates to the skill respec transaction, not an independent trainer-side point reset.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Author DA_Trainer_Tovin with Blacksmithing entry, IronHatchet recipe and class respec service.
  2. Assign trainer service to NPC_Tovin without copying character progress into its Blueprint.
  3. Use WBP_Skills/WBP_Crafting relevant panels or a trainer offer tab with read-only offer views and pending actions.
  4. Reopen wallet/skill/craft components to consume committed unlock entitlements.
  5. Test locked, already-known, insufficient funds and concurrent purchase cases.

Reopen Phase20 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / NPC_TovinTrainer / Offer_Blacksmithing. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Purchase same unlock twice -> one debit/entitlement.
Quest/reputation requirement changes -> RequirementsFailed or refreshed quote.
Client requests unlisted ability -> InvalidOffer.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Trainer costs/levels are proposals. Initial class baseline abilities remain available without a paid trap that blocks required progression.

Record offer/unlock/quote and receipt. Explain why an offer is locked in localized text.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
